title: Tobit 9
paragraphs: ¹ And Tobias called Raphael, and said to him, ² “Brother Azarias, take with you a servant and two camels, and go to Rages of Media to Gabael, and receive the money for me, and bring him to the wedding feast, ³ because Raguel has sworn that I must not depart. ⁴ My father counts the days; and if I wait long, he will be very grieved. ⁵ So Raphael went on his way, and lodged with Gabael, and gave him the handwriting; so he brought forth the bags with their seals, and gave them to him. ⁶ Then they rose up early in the morning together, and came to the wedding feast. Tobias blessed his wife.
